//: ettle hooks — see hooks/README.md. `ettle init <room> --install-hooks` merges these for you; this file is the same thing to paste by hand. Put them in ~/.claude/settings.json so they serve EVERY project: the commands name no room because each project's .ettle-room says which room it belongs to, and a project without one makes every hook a silent no-op. Adjust the PostToolUse matcher to your Linear MCP server's tool prefix. horizon-hook injects the coordination tangles relevant to you at session start; capture-hook distills THIS session and publishes your own atoms; pull-hook ingests teammates' Linear replies. Together they are the set-and-forget loop: install once, works in every session with no command to run.
